items.title: SCMP opinion piece says a turbulent tech fortnight raises urgent questions about AI
items.description: The opinion column recounts a turbulent fortnight in technology, including Jensen Huang's resignation from and reinstatement at Nvidia, Anthropic's stock market debut, and a US tech share sell-off, arguing these events raise urgent questions about AI.

items.title: Nvidia pauses server chip shipments to four Southeast Asian countries
items.description: TechCrunch reports Nvidia told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the US tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.

items.title: 4Minds argues decoupled knowledge graphs let enterprises swap foundation models
items.description: The excerpt presents a 4Minds LinkedIn post arguing that an enterprise AI platform's knowledge graph, memory and reasoning layers should be decoupled from any single foundation model so context work survives model switches. It frames these assets as intellectual property built from organizational data.

items.title: Dance-studio AI experiment suggests people should help shape the technology they use
items.description: The Conversation describes an experiment in an Auckland dance studio where the authors built an AI people can dance with, suggesting an approach to AI that gives people more say in shaping the technology they use.

items.title: Microsoft says hackers in China and North Korea are using the ARTEX AI tool to break into global tech systems
items.description: The Register reports Microsoft's warning that state-linked hackers in China and North Korea are using the ARTEX AI tool, described as an agentic offensive framework that automates familiar attack techniques, potentially breaching weak defenses in minutes.

items.title: SAP explores at least 10,000 job cuts as AI reshapes the software sector
items.description: The Financial Times reports that SAP is exploring at least 10,000 job cuts, described as the latest European software group to restructure as AI affects the software sector.

items.title: Andrew Bailey says unreleased AI models have raised encryption concerns
items.description: The Financial Times reports Andrew Bailey's warning that unreleased AI models have raised encryption concerns, with breakthroughs in mathematics stoking fears that data across financial systems is under threat.

items.title: Quoted commentary describes AI-generated voice and text becoming pervasive across media and communications
items.description: Simon Willison quotes Jack Despain Zhou arguing that generative AI has caused a 'great de-individualization,' with Claude's voice heard in videos and presentations and AI-written pitches appearing in inboxes.

items.title: TrustGraph masterclass argues only real ontologies can disambiguate word meanings that vector search conflates.
items.description: The video description presents a TrustGraph masterclass using a James Bond example to distinguish schemas from ontologies, arguing vector embeddings and auto-generated 'ontologies' cannot separate meanings of the same word, and that rule-based processes belong in graphs rather than tables.

items.title: Antonello Monti post urges semantic interoperability as explicit federated digital twin capability
items.description: The excerpt is a LinkedIn post by Antonello Monti stating that the main conclusion is that semantic interoperability should become an explicit capability of federated Digital Twin and Data Space architecture.

items.title: Databricks rethinks read replicas for its Lakebase architecture
items.description: The Databricks blog examines the idea behind read replicas — adding capacity when an app gets busy — and rethinks their role in the Lakebase architecture.

items.title: LinkedIn post lists semantic layer standardization and PII masking as steps for AI-ready data.
items.description: The uploader describes a checklist in which a semantic layer standardizes business definitions and metrics for consistent AI-generated insights, alongside PII masking to detect and redact sensitive data.

items.title: LinkedIn post argues semantic layer hype masks a deeper need to restructure information systems.
items.description: The uploader argues that marketing momentum around the semantic layer masks a deeper need to restructure existing information systems to achieve a genuine outcome, cut off in the snippet.

items.title: Hugging Face blog introduces llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon
items.description: The Hugging Face Blog post is listed as introducing a llama.cpp benchmark dashboard for AMD Ryzen and Radeon hardware; no excerpt is available to describe its contents.

items.title: LinkedIn post introduces Querio as git-native analytics for humans and agents.
items.description: The uploader describes Querio as git-native analytics and offers a primer on what context and semantic layers mean, arguing AI needs context such as warehouse contents and metric definitions.
